text.name: limeDrop_help_header
text.text: How it works

text.name: limeDrop_help_start_title
text.text: Getting started

text.name: limeDrop_help_start_1
text.text: Heap Delivery lets you order bulk products such as lime, manure or straw and have them dropped as a heap on a spot you choose. Open this menu with Alt+L while on foot.

text.name: limeDrop_help_start_2
text.text: Press New zone, look at the ground where the heap should go and left click to place the zone. Then press Order on its row, pick the product and the amount, and confirm.

text.name: limeDrop_help_start_3
text.text: The money is taken when you order. After the delivery time the heap appears in the zone and you get a message.

text.name: limeDrop_help_place_title
text.text: Placing a zone

text.name: limeDrop_help_place_1
text.text: A circle follows where you look, up to 60 m away. Green means it can go there, red tells you why not. Left click places it, right click cancels.

text.name: limeDrop_help_place_2
text.text: A zone must lie fully on land your farm owns and stay 1 m away from your other zones. Each farm can have up to %d zones.

text.name: limeDrop_help_place_3
text.text: While you move the circle, the slope of the ground under it is shown. On steep ground it warns you that part of a delivery may be tipped next to the zone (see Slopes).

text.name: limeDrop_help_place_4
text.text: Placing stops if you get into a vehicle, pick up a tool or an object, or open a menu. Zones are named after their field (Field 3, a second one Field 3a); Rename adds a description.

text.name: limeDrop_help_sizes_title
text.text: Sizes and capacity

text.name: limeDrop_help_sizes_1
text.text: Zones are circles 4, 6 or 8 m wide. New zones use the last size you picked. Change a zone with Edit, then Size.

text.name: limeDrop_help_sizes_2
text.text: On flat ground each size holds a fixed amount:

text.name: limeDrop_help_sizes_3
text.text: The order slider offers the room that is left: the capacity minus what already lies in the zone.

text.name: limeDrop_help_order_title
text.text: Ordering and prices

text.name: limeDrop_help_order_1
text.text: Order opens the order screen of a zone. Pick the product with the selector and the amount with the slider or the - and + buttons, in steps of 500 L.

text.name: limeDrop_help_order_2
text.text: The price is the current price of the product in the game, including the economy difficulty, plus a delivery fee. The receipt shows both.

text.name: limeDrop_help_order_3
text.text: Right now a delivery takes %s and the fee is %s.

text.name: limeDrop_help_order_4
text.text: Each zone takes one delivery at a time. Order stays grey until it arrives, and the zone list counts down the time left.

text.name: limeDrop_help_slopes_1
text.text: Heaps are formed by the game itself, and it can only keep a heap on ground that is not too steep. Each product piles a little differently.

text.name: limeDrop_help_slopes_2
text.text: On a slope the zone may hold only part of an order. The rest is tipped right next to the zone, on your own land and away from your other zones, so you still get the full amount. The delivery message tells you how much went next to the zone.

text.name: limeDrop_help_slopes_3
text.text: Only when all the ground around is very steep is the remaining amount refunded.

text.name: limeDrop_help_slopes_4
text.text: A heap on a slope can look bigger than one on flat ground. It is the same amount: it spreads wider and stands taller on the downhill side.

text.name: limeDrop_help_products_1
text.text: You can order: %s. The icon above the product selector shows which one is picked.

text.name: limeDrop_help_products_2
text.text: Different products cannot share a heap. A zone only takes the product already lying in it until that heap is used up.

text.name: limeDrop_help_products_3
text.text: Products pile differently, so how much fits depends on the product (see Sizes and capacity). Straw, hay and grass are light and fluffy and need much more room per liter.

text.name: limeDrop_help_history_title
text.text: History and refunds

text.name: limeDrop_help_history_1
text.text: History shows the last %d deliveries of a zone: when, which product, how much arrived, the amount paid in red and any refund in green.

text.name: limeDrop_help_history_2
text.text: Refunds include their share of the delivery fee. If you sell the land before a delivery arrives, the whole order is refunded.

text.name: limeDrop_help_history_3
text.text: The game places heaps in small whole pieces, so the last few liters of an order are topped up for free instead of being refunded.

text.name: limeDrop_help_settings_title
text.text: Settings and multiplayer

text.name: limeDrop_help_settings_1
text.text: Delivery time and delivery fee are under Settings, Game Settings, Heap Delivery. They are saved with the savegame; in multiplayer only the host or an admin can change them.

text.name: limeDrop_help_settings_2
text.text: Hide markers in this menu hides the zone circles and labels for you only.

text.name: limeDrop_help_settings_3
text.text: Zones belong to your farm, and only your farm can order for them. Descriptions typed with Rename go through the game's profanity filter.
